C0577.title: Fuzhou Click Farming Case: Four Convicted of False Advertising
C0577.summary: In August 2025, the Taijiang District Court in Fuzhou, Fujian Province, concluded a click farming case involving a food delivery platform. The defendants, led by an individual surnamed Huang, operated a workshop controlling over 150 mobile phones to fabricate orders and positive reviews for merchants. They generated more than 120,000 fake orders with an actual payment amount of 7.13 million yuan,

references.title: Do Not Fake Five-Star Reviews: The High Criminal Cost
